Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
FADE IN:

INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY

The room is filled with officials, reporters, and cameras. A large banner reads "WORLD RECORD HOLDER" in bold letters. At the center of the room, a frail but determined 127-year-old man, GEORGE, stands proudly, his eyes shining with tears. He is presented with a certificate and a gold medal.

GEORGE
(overcome with emotion)
I... I don't understand. I'm just a simple man from a small town. I've lived a long life, but this? It's just... it's just...

The officials and reporters erupt in applause as George is congratulated and interviewed.

CUT TO:

INT. GEORGE'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

George lies in bed, the gold medal and certificate displayed proudly on his nightstand. He looks tired but content. As he drifts off to sleep, he begins to think back to his youth.

GEORGE (V.O)
I remember reading about this theory online, back when I was a young man. Quantum Immortality. It said that if you lived long enough, you would eventually experience a multiverse, where every possible outcome of every event existed in a separate reality.

George's eyes glaze over as he becomes lost in thought.

GEORGE (V.O) (CONT'D)
It was just a theory, of course. But the more I thought about it, the more it made sense. I mean, think about it. Every time I made a decision, every time I took a step, every time I breathed... it was all just a probability. And what if I was just one of many versions of myself, living out different lives in different realities?

George's voice becomes a whisper, his words barely audible.

GEORGE (V.O) (CONT'D)
What if I'm not just one person, but a multitude of people? What if I'm the sum of all my possible selves?

The camera zooms in on George's face, his eyes wild and unfocused.

GEORGE (V.O) (CONT'D)
And what if I'm not just a person, but a universe? A multiverse of universes, each one containing a different version of me?

George's voice rises to a scream, his body shaking with rage and despair.

GEORGE (V.O) (CONT'D)
I'M NOT JUST ONE PERSON! I'M EVERY PERSON! I'M EVERY POSSIBLE OUTCOME! I'M THE SUM OF ALL MY POSSIBLE SELVES!

The camera zooms out as George's body contorts in agony, his mind shattered by the weight of his own existence.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

INT. GEORGE'S BEDROOM - LATER

George lies in bed, his body still shaking with sobs. The gold medal and certificate are still displayed on his nightstand, but they seem insignificant now. The camera lingers on George's face, his eyes vacant and lost.

GEORGE (V.O)
I don't know what's real anymore. I don't know what's true. I just know that I'm not alone. I'm not just one person. I'm... I'm...

The camera fades to black as George's voice trails off into silence.
